patterns.note: Full-bleed hero section featuring a large lifestyle image or video with elegant, centrally aligned text overlay and a call-to-action button.
A sophisticated serif font is used for prominent headings, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and UI elements, creating a luxurious yet accessible feel.
A muted, natural color palette dominates, with off-white backgrounds and dark grey text, allowing vibrant product packaging colors (lavender, teal, gold) to serve as primary accents.

The primary navigation bar transitions from transparent with white text to a solid dark background with white text and a subtle bottom border as the user scrolls past the hero section, becoming sticky at the top.
Product display sections utilize a clean grid layout, often featuring product images against a simple white background, with minimal text for product names and prices.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a full-width video background that plays silently, providing dynamic visual interest without distracting from the overlaid text. This is likely achieved using the `video-hero` technique.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely powered by GSAP, reveal content sections as they enter the viewport. Elements within these sections appear with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect, creating a smooth and engaging reveal experience.
The main navigation bar uses CSS transitions to smoothly change its background color, text color, and add a subtle border when it becomes sticky after the user scrolls past the initial hero view.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant and balanced; large, thin serif headings (~3x body) are paired with clean, readable sans-serif body text, with smaller uppercase labels for product categories.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and product card containers, creating a soft and refined aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, particularly in hero and testimonial sections, with product grids maintaining a slightly denser but still clean arrangement.

standout: The site's standout feature is its exceptional product photography and videography, which elevates the brand to a luxury status. The seamless integration of a high-quality video hero with elegant typography creates an immediate sense of aspiration and sophistication, making the products feel like art pieces.
